Corollary
[Riemann curvature evolution in $(4,0)$-form] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0192 1. Corollary 6.14\group evolution-of-curvature-under-the-ricci-flow

Under the Ricci flow, the $(4,0)$-Riemann curvature tensor satisfies the reaction-diffusion equation obtained by lowering the upper index in Lemma 6.13.
